items.name: Remaining performance obligations, April 30, 2026
items.claim: Planet's remaining performance obligations increased 81% year over year to $816 million.
items.source_excerpt: Increased RPOs +81% YoY to $816 Million; Backlog +72% YoY to over $906 Million

items.name: Backlog, April 30, 2026
items.claim: Planet's backlog (remaining performance obligations plus the cancelable portion of contract value) grew 72% year over year to over $906 million.
items.source_excerpt: Increased RPOs +81% YoY to $816 Million; Backlog +72% YoY to over $906 Million

notes: Both items sourced from the stored 8-K exhibit 99.1 (Q1 FY2027 results, filed 2026-06-04), which carries Planet's own RPO/backlog headline figures. No project- or named-contract-award disclosure was found in the same document.
